description_en: Queries the input and output information about a node. Only the ancestor or descendant nodes at the nearest level can be queried each time
description_zh: 查询当前节点的输入输出信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-node-input-or-output --node-id 12314567 --project-env PROD --io-type output --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodeInputOrOutput

parameters.description_en: The node ID. You can call the [ListNodes](~~173979~~) operation to query the ID.
parameters.description_zh: 节点的ID。您可以调用[ListNodes](~~173979~~)接口查看NodeId的相关信息。
parameters.help_en: The node ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 节点的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html接口查看NodeId的相关信息
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.description_en: The environment of the workspace. Valid values: DEV and PROD.
parameters.description_zh: 运行的环境，包括DEV（开发环境）和PROD（生产环境）。
parameters.help_en: The environment of the workspace. Valid values: DEV and PROD

parameters.description_en:
The type of node that you want to query. Valid values:

*   input: ancestor node
*   output: descendant node
parameters.description_zh:
用于指定查询节点为上游节点还是下游节点。取值如下：
- input，上游节点。
- output，下游节点。
